reviews.comment: Just don't take him unless you have to. He's so condescending. The whole class is about AI. He uses AI to generate the lectures, exams, grades, and yet claiming he's teaching us how to be AI proof. He made the class a total mess. Definitely a thinker, not a doer. He just has to compare himself to us to make him feel better about himself.

whole class is busy work that is def graded with ai bc why were the assignment comments on 5+ ppl's assignments the same... i said instructions for an assignment were unclear and he told me to talk to the TA (who had no office hours or contact info)

This professor was the instructor for my study abroad to Asia. He was very rude to the students when we would ask questions about basic things like meeting times, homework deadlines, and free time. Despite being in a foreign country where over 90% of the group was allowed to drink legally, he would threaten us constantly about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This guy is super chill everyone that rates him badly are just mad because they didn't show up to class. If you show up and put in the work the lowest grade you will get is a B. If you want the A just make sure you really focus on the first exam also there's a AWS certificate exam that will get you a 100 on his final super straight forward class.

AVOID IF YOU CAN! I heard bad things about Gomillion but gave him the benefit of the doubt & I DEEPLY regret it. All of his assignments take an ungodly amount of time to complete & some have vague instructions but it is difficult to ask questions because of how unapproachable & condescending he is. Attendance is mandatory, 0 credit given if late.

He is the most condescending teacher I have ever had. You ask him a question and instead of answering he just tells you to reread the assignment or the announcement, both of which didn't answer my question in the first place. He changes his opinions on assignments, even after you have finished it. He is also really unapproachable. Don't recommend.

This class begun with graded homework reading due before the syllabus class day. Knowing that, you should know what kind of class you have gotten yourself into. Only take this class if you have infinite time to spend homework on one class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. G's class was valuable. Each week there is a notebook to complete, which consists of completing definitions and AWS labs. If you write 3-4 sentences on each definition and complete the labs you will do well. First midterm is meant to be hard to incentivize students to take the AWS Certification, so you will be fine even if you do not score well
Bro didn't round me up from an 89.96

Honestly, it is very easy to get an A in the class. The grading criteria is clear, I should have done a better job at following it. Though, Dr. G is clear in what he expects from his students. I think once you get through ISTM250, this class truly starts to give you a fundamental view of MIS, and you truly learn. He does want you to succeed.
please do yourself a favor and avoid this guy like the plague. Between the wa

Gomillion is good at explaining things in-depth, however he speaks very fast and if you don't catch what he said, too bad because he doesn't post slides or have a textbook for this class. He just has a topic for the day such as security, network storage, etc, and talks about it for the whole class session. Also be prepared for LOTS of busy work.

BEWARE!! This guy is one of the most condescending and rude professors I've ever had to deal with. I haven't even finished the class and I'm not sure I'll be able to because he reported me to the honors council for "plagiarizing" definitions. His class isn't that hard, but he gets trigger-happy when it comes to reporting students.

No empathy for students, useless assignments/discussions, and an aggressive know-it-all attitude. Offers no help and constantly belittles students in class, do not even attempt to ask a question. absolutely avoid this prof for ANY class. I am convinced half of these positive reviews are him reviewing himself b/c this is the common opinion at Mays.

The concept for this seminar was good and I feel like it exposed us to a lot of different careers. However, it was quite unorganized (which he admitted). Quizzes that he would give were so precise and you had to make sure to listened to every little detail, which was kind of annoying. Overall, I am satisfied with the course.

I was skeptical of Gomillion at first, but he turned out to be a really good instructor. Although at times we would get frustrated because he wouldn't explicitly help us, he definitely made us learn from our mistakes and improve from there. However, at times it would seem like his responses were a bit too negative (made me feel dumb). Overall good

The worst iteration of this class I have ever taken. The epitome of busywork that has no point, this class was horrendously managed under him and was a huge headache. All that would be excused if he wasn't one of the most disrespectful, uncaring professors I have ever had, especially in a pass fail class. Never again.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His policies are strict and extreme. He would not excuse attendance for immovable internship/full-time job interviews... let that sink in. Does he really care for your future if he docks you on striving for one?

I have taken this class 2 times before, and this is the first time Gomillion is teaching it. Worst iteration of the class. Attendance is EVERYTHING - even more than learning. This class structure made me stress more about this one-hour class than my 3-hour core courses! He is rude and condescending to his students - avoid his classes or just beware

He is caring professor who considers his students and their future. At the beginning of the semester, I went down the deep end, but he pulled me aside and helped me see that I can do the work and now I am one of his A students. If you have any questions, then ask in person. Remember to breath, try, and ask, you got this!

(also 481) I was Initially skeptical of Dr. Gomillion (a pop quiz and cheating lecture kicked off the semester). Still, he turned out to be an outstanding prof at Texas A&M. He prioritizes learning, skips pointless assignments, and genuinely engages with students' questions. You will realize his fairness and desire for you to grow; just be patient.

Has an obsession with student's attendance in the class, yet cannot bother to show up for classes. Quizzes designed to trick you on a pass fail class with super specific tiny details. Taken this class twice before and it has never been like this, until he was in charge of it. Disappointed at the level of distrust show towards students.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The content of the class was great. Having professional come in to speak is great. Having Gomillion execute it, not so great. This class would have been a great experience had someone else taught it. Gomillion may be a smart guy, but not all smart people should be professor.

Dr. G is a complex guy. Yes, he can be arrogant and rigorously adheres to rules, arguably to a fault. Nonetheless, he is undoubtedly one of the most knowledgeable professors I have had during my time at A&M. Ultimately, it's clear that he genuinely cares about his students' success, both in their academic pursuits and in life.

This professor has a chip on his shoulder or something - attendance in his classes are greater than everything... greater than learning. One time he even delayed class because he had three different levels of attendance. Gomillion is also super passive aggressive when he talks. Worst professor because every class w/ him was the worst experience.

Makes quizzes tricky on purpose. I went to class and even then it was hard. He wants you to fail in a pass/fail class. This is my last seminar class that the school requires. The class was chill last two times I took it with Becker but Gomillion made it horrible.

This professor takes himself way too seriously. This is a one hour class where he offers three different kinds of ways to take attendance and scolds you if you are late. He assigns homework at all different times and even on weekends. The aspect of having panelists coming to speak is great but he made it dreadful and robotic.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Creates multiple assignments to "catch" students through attendance policies. Assignments posted with no consistency - he posted a quiz at 6 pm to be due at midnight on a Friday - no warning. 0 respect for student's time, and attacks students at every opportunity for perceived slights of laziness and limited motivation in a PASS FAIL class.

For a class that is not for a grade, your life had to revolve around it. Quizzes were posted on Fridays but time was not consistent (can be 12pm, can be 6 pm ..who knows) and were due the same day. Same thing with videos and assignments (all posted at random time but were still due that same day). No structure.
Avoid him
NEVER ask for help.
Never had a teacher who prays for students down fall as much as him. Uninspiring for student. Some people should not be professor
Doing the most fr
Did not explain things well when you emailed him or when you asked for one on one help. The class was not hard.

Easy A if you go to class, do reflection/assignment, and especially AWS modules. Personal project is very interesting. Dr G is super caring. Although he seems skeptical and often asks you for problem assessment and related knowledge before giving a solution, he'll try his best to help you and explain in great detail. Absolutely taking him again!!

Grade distribution is very considerate, with everything being weighed equally: attendance, readings, assignments, and a final project. I would only complain that he is very stern in his policies to an almost extreme extent. He intentionally never gives solid As on any assignments because his belief is that there is no such thing as perfect work
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Expectations for class and assignments were almost never clear. When points were docked from assignments and students asked for an explanation, no reasons were given. For lack of better words and restrictions for posts on this site, Gomillion obnoxiously follows rules to a fault and often acts like the shortened nickname of Richard.

This class is very challenging and time-consuming. A large portion of the course is based on a semester-long coding project that is SQL-based. The TA has lots of office hours and is very helpful. Interactive textbook readings are due every week which can be tedious to complete. There are 2 exams, no final.

Dr G is the best professor I've had to date. His lectures are very interesting and sometimes comical, so it's easy to pay attention. I found him to be very inspiring for the field of Information Systems; it is exactly the class and professor every MIS undergrad needs to take. There is lots of group work and weekly assignments.

Truly such a great professor who wants you to learn as much as possible! Lectures are super informative & he tells awesome stories that make you want to pay attention! The group project can take up time, so keep that in mind. Before Thanksgiving, he took time to tell us to stay safe and look out for each other - SUPER caring!

This class is tough but turns out to be one of the better graduate MIS courses quality-wise. You'll need to learn very quickly how to use SQL and he expects you to do a lot of learning on your own. Ask lots of questions, that's how you get help from him. Yes, he's very strict, but he's a "by the book" person, so go by that and you'll do fine.

Lectures don't cover relevant material to grades/projects. Be prepared to do it yourself. Grading is bewildering, and expectations are not outlined well. Previous deliverable grades have hidden criteria you weren't graded on. Early grades are lies; watch out! Group projects have high barriers to entry, so you might get stuck doing it all.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Gomillion is by far the WORST professor I've had in my entire life. Not only is his lecture style boring and ineffective, but he is wholistically such an a**hole. So disrespectful to students, so inconsiderate, rude, and just not a pleasant person to be around. I think this class would've been fine had someone else taught it. 0 stars for David
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: If you know what you are doing it is a blow-off class, otherwise gg ez no re good luck.

Definitely go to class because if not, you will miss important material. If you ask questions in class, do the assignments, and do the textbook reading (which is an assignment itself), then you will be fine. Make sure to study, and read over textbook for the exam because they can be hard. Our class did not get a curve, so don't count on that.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Gomillion is incredibly passionate about what he does and really wants his students to succeed. I found him inspiring just as a person. The course itself has taught me more than any other course I took in my student career. At times, It wasn't easy, but in the end, I am extremely glad I had to take it.

Professor Gomillion's pre-lecture textbook participation assignments require an unnecessary amount of work. After a certain point, you are just participating to get the grade rather than learning. In class, he is quite passive-aggressive which did not create a great learning environment. During office hours, he is the same.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. G has a lot of assignments which can seem overwhelming at times, but they are so good at preparing us for exams -- you really don't need to study much if you've paid attention in class and done all your work. You can tell he really cares, and his lectures are fun and engaging. I'll miss having Dr. G as a professor

A lot of assignments/quizzes at least 1/2 a week, but as long as you do your work and read the material you'll be okay. This semester his TA was super nice, and Gomillion is also very helpful if you go to his office hours. Truly learned the most. The Semester case is overwhelming dont procrastinate for milestones.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gomillion is a great professor, he goes above and beyond when teaching the class. He does have a lot of homework and quizzes but if you attend the lectures and read the materials he posts then you shouldn't have a problem doing either. Overall, he really cares about his students and tries to make his grading criteria straight forward
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Gomillion truly cares about his students and wants to help them learn. That said, the structure of the class is very flimsy - lots of hw and quizzes, and classes are not only mandatory, but you MUST show up on time or you get a 0 (attendance counts for 10% of your grade). You learn LOTS of different topics which build, so keep up to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: 281/481 is very easy, just go to the lectures and take the quizzes. He doesn't ask for too much detail so as long as you go you should be able to pass the class. Paper is easy as well it's just a recap of the lectures.

Dr. Gomillion is a fantastic professor. Very knowledgeable and insightful throughout 310. However, class and textbook knowledge gives you maybe half of what you need to research on your own for the project. Whether this is ideal is student preference as I would have much rather learned more practical things that would assist in the group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I usually thought I understood things, but then didn't do well on the exams (which were our only grades, total of 5). His lectures are helpful for the most part because he repeats himself and does a summary at the end in case you missed anything.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't mesh well with his personality but I'll admit making everyone do so many in-class activities does make you learn. His tests are very doable. The group project/case competition double whammy makes your life very unpleasant for two weeks, so start early on the project.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: throughout the semester he provided meticulous feedback to each one of us. the way he teaches really ensures you learn stuff!

This is my first, but probably not last, experience having Dr G, as he is one of the few MIS profs. He's a nice man, but unfortunately his method of lecturing does not work well for me for this class. Seeing as this is so hands-on, I feel his expectation that you'll read the book and be ready to demonstrate the material in class isn't realistic.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. G assigns a lot of reading and homework. He wants us to come into class ready to discuss in detail the concepts we have learned just from the book. It's hard to learn the material as in depth as he would like and I wish he would teach examples in class rather than rely solely on our own individual reading. The concepts are tough to learn alone.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: After taking 250 with Ted, it's easy to think you're an idiot or you won't be good at MIS. Dr. G helps you realize that you can excel at this major and understand all the lingo. He is fantastic and he is one of the few MIS professors at Mays who actually makes sense.'

The best professor I have ever had. He really cares about his students and takes the time to help you understand. He wants his class to do well and tells everyone how proud he is after the exams are graded. This class is challenging but he is able to bring out the best in each of his students. You have to work for your grade but he's on your side.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in the Mays Business School - Info Department! Prof Gomillion gives really good feedback, is extremely patient with queries and gives amazing lectures! Ne ready for a lot of assignment but it is worth doing them because the Prof takes out the time to grade them and give personalized feedback!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: 310/320 are lots of work, but he's a great teacher who wants to give you a good grade if you put in the effort! would definitely take him again.

I feel like he didn't actually teach us anything that had to do with our semester project. His lectures were boring and nothing that you couldn't get from the textbook. The only reason to go to class is for the attendance quiz that will be a large part of your grade. Would not recommend, if you have another option, take it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. G is great. This class is interesting, but get ready for a lot of group project work that can seem extremely frustrating. The exams aren't super tough, but takes a lot of outside work with daily quizzes & occasional homework. Would definitely take again though, would love to have Dr. G again... he really wants his students to learn though.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. G is one of my favorite professors. He makes his class extremely interactive & interesting. There a quiz just about every day at beginning of class, so don't skip-- or be late. Quizzes will ultimately what makes or breaks you. The exams weren't terrible as long as you have kept up with reading & pay attention during review. Seems to truly care.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. G is honestly one of the few professors who really cares about his students. I really enjoyed his class. The material is foreign and difficult at times but he does a good job at explaining it at a beginners level then progressing from there. I learned a lot. Tests are fairly easy as he reviews from the actual test the class prior.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS
